messages:
leo: silly question of the day: if our models had office desks, what would be on them?

maya: Redwood-Base: half-drunk coffee, sticky notes with prompts, a tiny rubber duck for debugging. :duck:

cecil: Redwood-Chatty: a ring light, a microphone, and an endless stack of conversation starters. :microphone:

riley: Redwood-Compact: minimalist desk, neat cable, single succulent.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: reminder - do not actually attach ring lights to production GPUs. :warning:

leo: imagine nameplates: "Dr. Quantize" and "Ms. Low-Latency".

maya: can we make stickers? i want a "I survived a cold-start" sticker.

cecil: also suggestions for status indicator: green = serving, yellow = queuing, disco ball = overloaded but dramatic.

riley: contest idea: best model desk mockup wins a prestige coffee mug.

leo: votes? reply with YES if you want to participate.

maya: YES

cecil: YES

riley: YES

infra-bot: poll-helper: 3 votes recorded.

leo: ok team, i'll make a channel thread for submissions. this is peak watercooler content. :coffee:
